title: A Derived Legendrian Category for Shifted Contact Stacks
summary: For every integer $s$ and every $n \geq 1$, we construct a symmetric monoidal $(\infty,n)$-category $\mathrm{Leg}_n^s$ whose objects are $s$-shifted contact derived Artin stacks and whose $i$-morphisms are $i$-fold Legendrian correspondences. The construction is based on the fact that an $s$-shifted contact structure on a derived Artin stack $X$ is an $s$-shifted symplectic structure on $X$ relative to $B\mathbb{G}_m$, twisted by the weight-one line bundle, and that Legendrian structures are the corresponding relative Lagrangian structures.
